mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.08% is historically low and consistently associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the accommodative monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPIAUCSL above 275 (current level 270.98) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 275 and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000 thousand) signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to accelerating inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 AND PAYEMS > 100000 and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 600000), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns due to overvaluation and the anticipation of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 AND RSAFS > 600000 and S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0 and S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 19100 billion (current level 19086.375) indicates a robust economy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 19100 and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
